translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
. ( aey payghumber ! ) yaqeen jano hum ney tumhen kausar ata kerdi hai ,
lehaza tum apney perwerdigar ( ki khushnoodi ) kay liye namaz parho , aur qurbani kero ,
yaqeen jano tumhara dushman hi woh hai jiss ki jarr katti hoi hai .
